decision.rationale: I checked the time limit first. TXN-008066 posted on 2026-09-24 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, which is 34 days later and inside the 120-day limit. The ledger shows two purchases at MEADOWLARK ELECTRONICS (MER-000032) on card CRD-000114, both for 96300 EUR minor units (963.00 EUR) and both posted on 2026-09-24. TXN-008065 is dated 2026-09-23T09:00:38Z and TXN-008066 is dated 2026-09-23T09:04:38Z. Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008259, an approved request for 963.00 EUR. That means one authorisation was posted twice. Neither posting has been refunded: the merchant's transaction list for this card shows no refunds. Under the policy for one authorisation posted twice, the extra posting, TXN-008066, gets provisional credit. That credit is 963.00 EUR, the amount of one posting, which matches the claim and is below the 3,000.00 EUR limit for provisional credit.
